candidate_evidence_scope.owner_reuse: registration/metadata/OS-event baseline includes F warm; no candidate implemented
candidate_evidence_scope.reduce_output_copy: save explicit payload/header copies plus original send ownership lifetime; no borrowed-send approval

design_revision_reason: parent latest instruction: retain the smaller 2048 budget and add explicit hard_events_per_thread_max before any execution

future_validation.functional: W1 exact marker/label/count/all values remain checked; per-output bytes/SHA/length equal matching original W1 and acrosspool modes
negative_design: wrong copy byte count or owner generation
unexpected Core/growth path in normal run
future_validation.reuse: existing W4 queue and W2 fixed auditor; do not rerun accepted fixed probes
future_validation.warm_byte_oracle: N3 owning warm observation versus canonical original W1 work0 under the same input, mode and budgets; no claim of an original W1 warm artifact
future_validation.warm_lifetime_change: short owning Sample block archives output and destroys it before work0; longer warm string lifetime and file I/O are diagnostic preparation overhead; no added arena owner or arena moves

planned_output_only_in_W2.raw_w1_stdout: unchanged W1 revision2 JSON; phase durations archive only

predictions_not_results.P_equal: must assert Pi=Po using original W1 outputs
predictions_not_results.after_run_teardown: active registry0, domains1/3/4/5 outstanding0, domain2 exactly one preflight-created retained bucket allocation16 bytes on pinned libc++
predictions_not_results.construction_prefix: match load_payload_copy/OS/pool events before registry_register to the unique later successful register in the same thread, endpoint/cycle/load phase and base; never use the prior ended generation

domain5_per_verified_load.assumption: frozen libc++ vector capacities1/2/4/8 and sizeof(WireValidationRange)=16; reject mismatch
domain5_per_verified_load.peak_scope: domain5 local load peak, and domain5 peak along this strictly synchronous chain; not all-domain or process peak

prohibited_inferences: phase times sum to end-to-end saving
byte share is latency saving share
pool idle mappings are simultaneously live owners
network synthetic result is production benefit

recorder_budget.dump: only after run/fixture returned and worker joined; no emitting thread overlaps serialization
recorder_budget.forecast_exceeded_policy: planned and hard thresholds are separately named but both 2048; exceeding the forecast is also a hard violation, with no grace range
recorder_budget.hard_violation_policy: over 2048 or other hard validity/thread/label/dropped failure rejects all costs for that condition and stops later conditions pending parent review; preserve raw records; no automatic rerun or expectation editing
recorder_budget.on_overflow_or_budget_violation: fail and stop; no interpretable costs; changing limits requires explicit new design revision and dispatch

bounded_data: two work records and optional one warm record, each server/client IOProgress and receive logical init/header-copy/size/capacity
preflight, pool init, before-final-clear and final resource checkpoints
phase+thread+registry-generation cost summaries plus original allocation-subject ledger
at most one extra owning warm response file per warm case; compare to canonical original W1 work0 oracle; explicit diagnostic archival overhead
not_costs: W1 timing fields are archived only
capacity snapshots are not physical allocation bytes
logical string init is not actual libc memset
socket bytes are not memcpy or kernel copy counts
sidecar_draft.retained_policy: exact domains and request class/count/bytes/subject origin checked, not generic allow-domain2
sidecar_draft.server_string_completion: checkpoint after Worker result_=serve_one(...) returns and before existing done publication; no guard mutation of returned local ServerResult and no NRVO dependency

units_and_checkpoints.client_output_capacity: snapshot after receive assignment while output live
units_and_checkpoints.extra_pool_stats: label diag.pool.check, retain lock events and separate diagnostic-only query cost
units_and_checkpoints.hash_binding: native raw observation first; post-exit collector emits final immutable sidecar binding stdout/trace/binary/outputs without changing W1 stdout
units_and_checkpoints.header_assembly: completed original memcpy calls and 88-byte extent; separate from socket bytes
units_and_checkpoints.receive_capacity: uint64 char capacity excluding terminator; snapshot while string live, not backend bytes
units_and_checkpoints.receive_size_init_extent: uint64 wire bytes including the 88-byte header; logical constructor request
units_and_checkpoints.saved_capacity: snapshot after save while owning saved string live
units_and_checkpoints.server_strings_released: boolean set in worker after serve_one returns, before done publication; C++ lifetime only

source_bindings_policy.context_meaning: the W3 file hash identifies the read-only control reference observed while designing; the explicit controls in this plan are fixed independently, and later W3 artifact binding does not block this design
source_bindings_policy.strict_inputs: W1 prepared-v2 source/result and accepted revision2; accepted W2 frozen foundation/runtime/catalog
